## Why it still says "Pull request open"

Your local `prelude/design-workspace` branch has two commits that came after the push. Main doesn't have them, so Prelude can't tell that the branch was merged.

The branch's reflog (`.git/logs/refs/heads/prelude/design-workspace`) shows:

- **Line 10:** `3625084` "The last chat notes (committed by Prelude, publishing)". This is the commit that was pushed. `origin/prelude/design-workspace` is still at `3625084`, and it's what PR #32 merged into main (`2fe02dd`).
- **Line 11:** `e2adc23` "Design Workspace: 3 pages don't render". This is a turn after the push.
- **Line 12:** `fa76c61` "Design Workspace: I approved everything again…". This is another turn, and it's the branch's tip now.

Here's how the app decides whether a branch is merged:

- `server/branches.js:476` counts a branch as merged only if its tip is already in main: `merge-base --is-ancestor tip main`. The tip `fa76c61` isn't in main, so `merged` is false.
- So `tidy()` (`branches.js:650`) skips it, and the worktree and its build record are never removed.
- The branch's record still has `published` set, which `publish()` wrote at `branches.js:625`. Nothing ever clears it. Because of that:
  - The project page shows the "Pull request open" pill (`project.js:238` → `views/projects/_branch.eta:21`).
  - Home lists it as a pull request waiting for review (`home.js:168–177`, `home.js:243`).
- The session's own "Pushed … and opened a pull request: …" line is a note written into the transcript at publish time (`main.js:462`, `noteOnBranch`). It never updates.

So after a push, any later turn on the branch moves its tip past what the PR contains. Once the PR is merged, the app has no way to see it. I can't tell from here what those two commits changed. `git log --stat main..prelude/design-workspace` will show you. If they only touched session files, nothing real is lost. If the agent changed code in them, that work isn't in main.

One smaller thing: the session page never runs the check itself. `tidyFolder` returns early for a branch folder (`main.js:890`), so the check only happens from Home and the project page. That isn't the cause here, though. Even when the check runs, this branch fails it.

## What I'd change

- **`server/branches.js`, `publish()`:** record the commit that was pushed, as `published.tip`.
- **`server/branches.js`, `status()`:**
  - Report the pull request as merged when `published.tip` is in main or `origin/main`.
  - Also count the branch as merged when everything past main is under `sessions/` or `snapshots/`, the same filter `alsoChanges` already uses. Then a branch whose only extra commits are chat notes still gets cleaned up.
- **`server/project.js:238` and `server/home.js:168`:** show "Pull request open" only while the pushed commit isn't merged. If the PR is merged but the branch has newer work, show the branch as ordinary work in progress ("N changes since the merged pull request") instead of an open PR.
- **This branch, once that's in:**
  - If the two extra commits are only chat notes, the next check removes it.
  - If they change code, push them again for a new pull request.

It isn't a fluke. The same sequence will do it again every time, and this is just the first time that sequence has happened.

**It's deterministic.** `status()` in `server/branches.js:476` counts a branch as merged only if every commit on it is already in main. Here's what happened on this branch, from `.git/logs/refs/heads/prelude/design-workspace`:

1. Prelude pushed `3625084` and opened PR #32.
2. Before the merge, two more turns ran in the session ("3 pages don't render", then "I approved everything again…"). Prelude committed each one, which is how every turn is saved (`branches.js:450`). Neither was pushed.
3. PR #32 merged `3625084`. The two later commits were left out of main, so the check fails, and it will keep failing however many times it runs.

**Why you haven't seen it before.** Every earlier branch was pushed, merged and cleaned up with no turn in between. `packed-refs` lists remote branches for `build`, `landing-page`, `prelude-shell`, `project-landing-page` and ten `fix-…` branches. Not one of them is still a local branch: each was merged and removed. `prelude/design-workspace` is the only local `prelude/*` branch left, and it's the only one with commits after its push. The others each ended at the push. This one didn't, because you kept working in the session after pushing, so the app said "3 pages don't render" while the PR was still open.

So it will happen any time you send a message in a session after pushing and before the PR is merged. The changes I suggested earlier still apply:

- Record the pushed commit, and treat the PR as merged once that commit is in main.
- Don't count chat-only commits as unmerged work.

Before deciding what to do with this branch, run `git log --stat main..prelude/design-workspace` to see what those two turns changed.
